identification: Hand-hammered footed beaker or christening cup, engraved BILLIE 1927. Foot underside has a worn rectangular stamp (probably STERLING) and a separate quatrefoil maker's punch. No British hallmarks, so likely American or other non-British Arts and Crafts work. Maker unidentified; sterling unconfirmed.

chrome_hint: eBay AU and US sold/Terapeak: 'sterling hand hammered footed cup 1927', 'hand wrought sterling beaker arts and crafts', 'sterling christening cup hammered'. Image-search the quatrefoil/cross punch via 925-1000.com and silvercollection.it (American hand-wrought makers e.g. Kalo, Jarvie, Stone, Dominick & Haff style marks), then eBay sold for the identified maker. Also Leski, Theodore Bruce, Mossgreen and LiveAuctioneers for 'hand hammered sterling beaker' sold results; weigh the piece for a scrap-value floor.
viewing_check: Photograph and enlarge the quatrefoil maker's punch and the rectangular stamp (confirm STERLING or 925). Weigh it in grams for melt floor. Check for any further marks inside the foot or under the rim, dents and the foot join.
